author: martinshplerder
quote: i mostly played grand theft auto for story in the past. realism and other aspects for me were second priority in gta. yes gta 5 story isnt realistic at all but its fun to play and interesting. in gta 6 i think all money was spent on realism which is not fun at all. like i dont care about nightclubs or how snake moves i dont care about that i just want fun storytelling and fun characters. also they made it a romance game. i would have preferred jason to be a main character and lucia just some side character who you could have romantic relationship with (if you wanted to).
